business_profile.label: Snow And Grounds Maintenance Contractor
business_profile.name: Northline Winter Services Ltd.
business_profile.business_type: snow removal, salting, plowing, sidewalk clearing, and grounds maintenance contractor

chunks.text: Bidders must provide proof of insurance. Bidders shall submit WSIB clearance. Bidders shall provide a valid snow plow operator license for each driver.
The contractor shall perform snow removal, salting, plowing, and sidewalk clearing at municipal facilities. Proposals must be uploaded through the buyer portal before the submission deadline.
